name: Hiroshima Peace Memorial (Genbaku Dome)
description: In the heart of Hiroshima, the skeletal Genbaku Dome is the shell of a former exhibition hall that survived the atomic bomb of 6 August 1945, even though the blast went off almost directly above it. Its bare brick walls and twisted steel dome have been kept just as they were after the bombing. Standing beside the river in Peace Memorial Park, it is a quiet, sobering reminder of the war and a symbol of the hope for a world without nuclear weapons.
